Executive Summary

NKE rose from $4.47 to $61.81 between 2000-01-03 and 2026-01-30, generating a cumulative return of 1,282.3% and a CAGR of 10.60%.

The all-time low in this dataset was $2.47 (2000-02-25), while the all-time high was $166.25 (2021-11-05). The deepest peak-to-trough decline was -68.5%, from the prior peak on 2021-11-05 to the trough on 2025-04-08.

Key Takeaways and Investment Implications

Historically, NKE exhibits a strong long-run compounding profile with episodic deep drawdowns. The return stream is equity-like and cyclic, requiring tolerance for significant interim losses. Volume and volatility clustering around stress periods reinforces the importance of horizon discipline and position sizing for long-term holders.
